biotools.summary: pepa is a lightweight tool for visualizing and quantifying genomic inheritance, designed for beginner and advanced users. It processes VCF files, assigns ancestries to homozygous SNPs, and generates human-readable tables and chromosome paintings to analyze inheritance patterns.
